versionReason: initial independent preparation; input-availability evidence only, no new historical outcomes opened
signal: last completed local exchange session of each week, after finalized close
filingVisibility: strictly before signal date; KR valid receipt date; US max(availableFrom,acceptedDate)

universe.KR: strict-prior monthly historical Top120; retain departures, halts and unresolved identities in census
universe.US: strict-prior historical S&P500 community snapshots; retain departures and malformed symbols in census
universe.financialAndRealEstate: separate strata; primary nonfinancial cohort requires explicit dated classification approval
universe.identity: no current survivors filter, ticker-reuse bridging or successor substitution without dated evidence

layout: five absolute, disjoint RunLayout directories; no feature-label joined file

firstPilotProposal.reason: flow-based states have broader preserved coverage than asset-dependent features; no outcome-based choice
firstPilotProposal.supportAndControls: same approved eligible sample and level/industry/size controls; insufficient support stays BLOCKED
firstPilotProposal.budgetProposal: one market/horizon/fold, 8 GiB, 30 CPU minutes; source/legal/manual restoration separately estimated

patternsDEFG: dependency census and definitions only; separately version implementation before use

labels.entry: next local session finalized close; no same-signal-session execution
labels.exit: entry plus H local sessions, or verified terminal consideration
labels.economicReturn: gross shareholder total return including distributions and split-consistent shares
labels.excess: stock shareholder total return minus matched ETF shareholder total return
labels.winner: same-market same-date eligible measurable population top decile AND excess > 0
labels.bigLoss: same population bottom decile AND excess < 0
labels.unresolved: BLOCKED/UNRESOLVED, never zero/neutral or dropped from denominator
labels.percentileTies: include all ties at decile cutoff; report realized class counts
labels.labelRelease: after maturity close+buffer and all price/terminal/basis checks; record available_at
labels.cashAlternative: separately sourced/approved currency cash return; never silently assume zero

models: shallow boosting only under separate sample/spec gate
comparison.historicalHyperparameterSearch: none in initial run; any extension logged as additional exploratory trial
comparison.sharedSample: same date, market, horizon, eligibility, control strata and label policy; common plan hash plus feature/data hashes
controls: current revenue growth and margins without changes
comparison.missingness: reason-coded; training-only median plus missing indicators for partially measured numeric features; all-missing training columns dropped
comparison.modelSelection: expanding walk-forward VALIDATION; no outcome-informed change called independent OOS
comparison.walkForward: annual evaluation blocks in 2020-2024 when the eligible mature training-signal span is >=36 months; preserve immature 2025-2026 cohorts as censored
comparison.purge: all training label maturity and release strictly before label_deadline; no interval reaches evaluation_start
comparison.embargo: label_deadline <= training_cutoff minus 21 local sessions; fix exact UTC dates in authorized run manifest
comparison.historicalMinimumSupport: 500 training rows, 100 issuers, 20 signal dates and >=50 examples per binary class; otherwise BLOCKED
comparison.boostingMinimumSupport: 2000 training rows and 100 issuers plus separately approved implementation
comparison.overlapUncertainty: issuer clusters plus time blocks at least horizon length; overlapping weekly labels are not independent samples
comparison.informationOverlap: pairwise Spearman with pairwise counts; missingness Jaccard; event co-occurrence; train-only residualization; one-pattern removal on identical samples
predictiveReadout: PR-AUC/log loss/Brier and calibration on validation only
conditional excess error and rank correlation
large-loss false negatives and unsuccessful lookalikes
economicReadout: turnover from names and retargeting separately
matched ETF and currency cash separately
comparison.tradeCostEngine: existing benchmark_alpha/weekly_decision dated market costs; capacity/slippage must be explicitly pinned, no invented zero cost

explorationDisclosure.priorResearchExposure: KR sealed studies and published repository evidence already exist; no clean untouched historical OOS claim
explorationDisclosure.trialJournal: hash-chained trial_record, including failed/abandoned attempts, reason, parent and PRE_RESULT vs RESULT_INFORMED

stopBeforeOutcomeRead: no explicit authorization naming this protocol digest, approved code commit, exact folds, source hashes and output directories
unresolved data-use rights or missing source provenance
unverified ticker reuse, duplicate security/date identity or terminal consideration
stock/ETF price-versus-total-return basis mismatch or unverified action adjustment
insufficient class/cohort support, missing universe or unavailable filing dependencies
attempt to change sealed KR specs/results/locks or production policy
executionApproval: separate reviewable implementation/spec PR plus explicit user authorization; this JSON, a merge or C1 approval grants no execution permission
